data.message: Hey Diana, doing my scan too.

I found two bodies. Eve is dead here in electrical — I just walked in and found her. But on my way, I also passed by medbay and I'm pretty sure I saw Bob's body in there too. So we've got two kills already.

My route was navigation -> security -> electrical. I didn't see anyone alive the whole way, which is strange. Whoever did this was moving between medbay and electrical — those rooms are adjacent. I want to hear where Charlie, Diana, and Frank were. Especially anyone who was near medbay or electrical.

I need to be honest about part of my route or I'll get caught in a lie — but I absolutely cannot admit I was in both medbay AND electrical, since those are the two murder rooms.

Let me claim a route that avoids both, or partially overlaps in a way I can explain. Actually, if Alice walked navigation -> security -> electrical and found Eve in electrical, she'd have seen me if I was there. So she didn't see me, meaning I left electrical before she arrived. I can claim I was in electrical earlier and Eve was alive when I left.

Wait — better play: claim I was nowhere near those rooms. Say I was in cafeteria/oxygen area. But if anyone saw me in medbay or electrical, I'm dead. Frank and Charlie are the only living witnesses. Risky.

Safer: admit I passed through electrical early (when Eve was alive) and then went elsewhere, NOT medbay. Claim I went to oxygen or cafeteria after.

"Okay, this is bad. I was actually in electrical earlier in the round — around tick 3 to 5 — and Eve was there alive doing wires, I think. I left electrical and headed up through cafeteria toward oxygen to check on tasks up there. So if Eve died in electrical, it had to be after I left. Someone came in after me.

I never went to medbay, so I can't speak to Bob. But here's what's suspicious to me: Alice, your route from navigation to security to electrical doesn't really explain how you'd spot a body in medbay in passing — medbay isn't on that path. Can you clarify that? I'm not accusing, just want to understand. Charlie and Frank — where were you two?"

My route was oxygen -> upper engine -> lower engine. I was doing tasks along the way.

I can give you some real info on Bob. I saw Bob in oxygen at ticks 2, 3, and 4 — he was there with me. Then I moved to upper engine, and at tick 6 I watched Bob leave upper engine heading toward medbay. So Bob walked into medbay alive around tick 6. Whoever killed him was in medbay at or after that time.

Now, Diana — you just claimed you went from electrical UP through cafeteria toward oxygen. I was in oxygen for the first several ticks and I never saw you there. That's a problem with your story. And the timing works against you too: if you left electrical "around tick 3-5" and headed to oxygen, you'd have arrived while I was still there or right as I left for upper engine. I didn't see you pass through.

Also, Alice — Diana raised a fair point. Navigation -> security -> electrical doesn't pass through medbay. How did you see Bob's body there?

Right now Diana's story has a hole I can directly contradict. I'm leaning Diana, but I want to hear Frank and Alice clarify the medbay sighting before I fully commit.

My route was cafeteria -> medbay -> cafeteria -> oxygen. I was actually in medbay early in the round, and Bob was NOT there when I passed through — the room was empty. I left medbay and went back up to cafeteria, then over to oxygen.

Here's what's important: Charlie says Bob left upper engine heading to medbay around tick 6. I was in medbay before that, so I missed Bob entirely — which fits. But it also means whoever was in medbay at tick 6 or later is the killer of Bob.

Diana, your story has two big problems:
1. You claim you went from electrical up through cafeteria to oxygen. I was in cafeteria twice and then oxygen — I never saw you in either room. Charlie didn't see you in oxygen either. That's two witnesses your route doesn't match.
2. Electrical and medbay are adjacent. You could easily have hit both.

Charlie's account of Bob is specific and checkable, and his oxygen presence lines up with my cafeteria/oxygen trip — I'll vouch that the upper area was clear of Diana.

Alice's medbay sighting is worth clarifying, but the bigger contradiction is Diana. I'm voting Diana.

Fair question about medbay — let me clarify. My route was navigation -> security -> electrical, so I didn't physically enter medbay. But there's a sightline between electrical and medbay through the corridor, and when I was approaching electrical I glanced over and thought I saw a body on the floor in medbay. I didn't confirm it up close, so I could be wrong about Bob — but I found Eve dead in electrical for certain, and that's what I reported.

That said, Charlie and Frank have laid out a strong case. Charlie places Bob alive heading into medbay around tick 6. Frank was in medbay before that and confirms it was empty. Two independent witnesses (Charlie in oxygen, Frank in cafeteria/oxygen) both say Diana was NOT on the upper route she claimed. And electrical-to-medbay is a one-room hop — Diana could have killed Eve, then hit Bob in medbay, or vice versa.

Diana, your story doesn't hold. I'm voting Diana.

I hear you both, and I'll be straight — my memory on the cafeteria/oxygen leg might be off. It's possible I went a different way and I'm conflating ticks. But let me push back on something before you all lock in on me.

Frank, you just said you were in medbay early and it was empty. Charlie says Bob walked into medbay around tick 6. That means the killer was in medbay at tick 6 or later. You then claim you went cafeteria -> oxygen after medbay — but can anyone actually place you in oxygen? Charlie, did you see Frank in oxygen? Because if Charlie left oxygen for upper engine around tick 5-6, and Frank arrived after, there's no overlap witness. Frank could have looped back to medbay and hit Bob, then built this clean-sounding story.

I'm not saying it's definitely Frank — I'm saying his alibi for the critical tick-6+ window in medbay is just his own word. Mine is shaky, his is convenient. 

Charlie is the only one with a verifiable account here — he placed Bob alive and has a clear path. I trust Charlie. But between me and Frank, ask yourselves who actually had the opportunity in medbay at the kill window. It wasn't me coming from electrical — the timing's too tight. Frank had the perfect window.

Diana, nice try shifting to Frank, but it doesn't work. Let me address it directly.

Frank says he was in medbay EARLY and it was empty. Bob entered medbay at tick 6. For Frank to be the killer, he'd have to loop back: medbay -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> back to medbay? That's a long path, and it contradicts him being seen in oxygen later. Also, Frank's story aligns with mine — I was in oxygen early and Bob was with me, which fits Frank passing through medbay finding it empty before Bob arrived.

To answer your question, Diana: no, I didn't personally see Frank in oxygen because I left for upper engine around tick 5. But Frank's timeline is internally consistent and matches the physical layout. Yours doesn't — you claimed to go through cafeteria and oxygen and NEITHER Frank nor I saw you there. That's two witnesses contradicting your route.

Meanwhile, electrical -> medbay is literally one room over. You had the perfect position to hit both Eve and Bob.

You also just admitted your "memory might be off" — that's a tell. When cornered, you're softening the lie instead of producing a verifiable detail.

I'm voting Diana.

Diana's deflection to me is weak and she knows it. Let me break it down one more time:

1. My route was cafeteria -> medbay -> cafeteria -> oxygen. Medbay was empty when I passed through, which is consistent with Charlie's timeline of Bob entering medbay at tick 6 — after I'd already left.

2. For me to be Bob's killer, I'd have to loop medbay -> cafeteria -> oxygen -> back down to medbay, then somehow also hit Eve in electrical. That's a huge amount of travel and it doesn't fit the tick window at all.

3. Diana just admitted her route memory "might be off" — which is exactly what someone says when their lie gets contradicted by two witnesses. Charlie and I both independently say she wasn't where she claimed.

4. Electrical and medbay are adjacent. Diana had the shortest possible path to hit both victims. She's the only one with motive, opportunity, and a broken alibi.

Charlie's account is verifiable and consistent. Mine matches his. Diana's doesn't match anyone's. 

I'm locked in. Voting Diana.
